Maya (PM): Quick sync  I want to run a 6-week "latency-ladder" beta that prioritizes realtime user-facing flows. Need a short screener, a fast scoring rubric, and clear stopgates. Planning outreach next Mon.
Jon (Field Eng): Love the ladder naming. For screener keep it micro: feature blurb + p95 target + expected QPS + integration ETA. 1-2 minutes max.
Lina (Design): I'll make a compact microcopy for the screener and an onboarding banner. Suggest a tiny 'success checkbox' list: latency / cost / UX retention / accuracy.
Omar (SRE): We can offer a tiny Dedicated canary for top partners but only with an explicit fallback. I'll draft a routing policy and a degraded-capacity playbook. Need oncall windows listed in invite.
Rhea (Legal): Consent flag is required if we ask for logs. I'll supply a 2-line consent and offer retention choices (30/90/365 days). Default to 30.
Kai (Growth): Recommend A/B subject lines: A "Help us hit 100ms" vs B "Lower your inference costs". Track reply -> integration rate.
deply-bot: merge beta/invite-playbook <- main :tada:
Maya (PM): Scoring rubric idea: integration fit (1-5), effort (1-5), impact (1-5). Accept if >=11. Veto any on-prem-only ask.
Jon (Field Eng): Add a quick integration scorecard we can fill during triage: API readiness, model pin-ability, baseline eval artifacts.
Omar (SRE): Launch gates proposal: Recruit >=10 qualified across ladder rungs; Onboard >=3 validated in staging; Safety: no single partner causes >15% SLO breach; Value: at least 2 partners show >=15% median latency improvement. Pause outreach if gates fail.
Lina (Design): I'll prep banner copy: "Youre in our latency-ladder beta  onboarding steps inside" with CTA.
Rhea (Legal): I'll draft the consent + short DPIA checklist. Ping me for any dataset requests.
Kai (Growth): Incentives: $400 credit for startups, case-study/co-marketing for enterprise. Offer both. Fast-track Dedicated slot for top 2 partners.
Maya (PM): Action owners: Jon = triage scorecard + curl snippets; Lina = screener + banner; Omar = routing/runbook; Rhea = consent + retention; Kai = HubSpot form + A/B. I'll pull into a 1-pager by Thu EOD.
Jon (Field Eng): Happy to triage invites.
Omar (SRE): Stubbing runbook now.
Lina (Design): Will post microcopy tomorrow.
Rhea (Legal): Will review final before send.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. If no objections, outreach next Monday. :rocket:
